menstrual.title: Menstrual
menstrual.message: A quiet moment to turn inward.
menstrual.detail: Rest is its own kind of renewal.
menstrual.label: Menstrual phase
menstrual.headline:
You can slow
down today
menstrual.body: Your energy and comfort needs can change during period days. If it feels good, make room for rest, warmth and gentle movement. Resting and gentle movement like walking may be suitable for this time.
menstrual.fertility: Estimated chance of pregnancy is lower

follicular.title: Follicular
follicular.message: Your energy is beginning to bloom.
follicular.detail: A lovely time to follow your curiosity.
follicular.label: Follicular phase
follicular.headline:
Notice your energy
as it shifts
follicular.body: Your energy or sociability may rise in this phase, or it may feel much the same. Shape your plans around how you feel today.
follicular.fertility: Estimated chance of pregnancy is rising

ovulation.title: Ovulation
ovulation.message: A bright moment to feel your power.
ovulation.detail: Connect with what makes you glow.
ovulation.label: Estimated ovulation window
ovulation.headline:
How are you
feeling today?
ovulation.body: Energy, desire and social feelings can shift around estimated ovulation days. A calendar estimate cannot replace your own experience.
ovulation.fertility: Estimated chance of pregnancy is higher

luteal.title: Luteal
luteal.message: Slow down and honour your rhythm.
luteal.detail: Make space for what matters most.
luteal.label: Luteal phase
luteal.headline:
Soften your
pace a little
luteal.body: As your period approaches, your energy, focus and comfort needs may change. Choose the pace that feels right today.
luteal.fertility: Estimated chance of pregnancy is lower
